Running command: bash -lc 'cat > /tmp/find_gap.py <<"PY"
from pathlib import Path
import struct, subprocess, itertools, re, os
prefixes=[b"",b"> ",b"- ",b"* ",b"1. ",b"- > ",b"> > ",b"    ",b"| "]
links=[b"[a](b ", b"[a](<b> ", b"[x]: y ", b"![a](b "]
titles=[b"\"\\", b"\"a\\", b"\"abc\\", b"'\\", b"(\\", b"\"\\ ", b"\"\\\t"]
nls=[b"\n", b"\r\n"]
nexts=[b"", b"x", b" ", b"  ", b">", b"> ", b"> x", b"#", b"---", b"|x|", b")", b"\")", b"\"", b" )", b"  )"]
count=0
env=os.environ.copy(); env["ASAN_OPTIONS"]="detect_leaks=0"
for tup in itertools.product(prefixes,links,titles,nls,nexts):
    s=b"".join(tup)
    f=Path("/tmp/one.bin"); f.write_bytes(struct.pack("II",0x8ffff,0)+s)
    p=subprocess.run(["/tmp/fuzz_trace",str(f)],stdout=subprocess.DEVNULL,stderr=subprocess.PIPE,env=env)
    out=p.stderr.decode("latin1")
    for m in re.finditer(r"finished line_index=0 off=(\d+) line_end=(\d+) nextbeg=(\d+)", out):
        off,end,nextbeg=map(int,m.groups())
        if nextbeg!=999999 and off<nextbeg:
            print("GAP",repr(s),"off",off,"end",end,"nextbeg",nextbeg,"out",out[:500])
            raise SystemExit
    count+=1
print("no gap",count)
